title: Opaque Sticky Cores
description: Sodium 0.5 Slime & Honey Translucent fix using Fusion mod
body:
This resource pack replaces the model and textures for both the Honey block and the Slime block to have their inner cube opaque, this is a work-around for the translucency sorting issues with them in Sodium v0.5 and older.

![a comparison of with and without the resource pack in a split view](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/CEwbv3sR/images/761accd11ee18afd84756e6272c38e6ec0d0861a.png)

Minecraft 1.20.1 is stuck with Sodium v0.5, including the translucent sorting issue, this is what this resource pack aims to fix.

**NOTE:** this resource pack does not adapt with the resource packs you use

## This Resource pack requires [Fusion](https://modrinth.com/mod/fusion-connected-textures)
why? because minecraft dosent allow you to set if a texture is opaque or transparent in 1.20.1, That feature was only added in 26.1

### Why dosent it adapt to my resource pack?
- because the resource pack relies on a 2nd texture that IS opaque, with its own mcmeta file declaring that its an opaque texture, you can manually make it look like your resource pack by replacing the texture in this resource pack to match yours.
